title: AP Netflix VOID — ComfyUI Nodes for Video Object Deletion
summary: A ComfyUI implementation of Netflix's VOID model designed for advanced video inpainting. It removes objects along with their physical interactions, such as shadows and reflections, using a unique quadmask system.
research_notes: Introduced the quadmask system for physics-aware inpainting; widely used as the primary entry point for VOID in the ComfyUI ecosystem.

evolution.summary: Following the April 2026 release of the Netflix VOID model, this project evolved from a beta port into a refined node set. Community updates have introduced FP8 quantization for 24GB VRAM support and improved temporal consistency through two-pass pipelines.
